name: sunday-sidekick
description: A local-first fantasy football league companion

scripts.news:smoke: npm run build --workspace @sidekick/core && npm run build --workspace @sidekick/integrations && node scripts/news-smoke.mjs
scripts.sleeper:catalog:smoke: npm run build --workspace @sidekick/core && npm run build --workspace @sidekick/integrations && node scripts/sleeper-catalog-smoke.mjs
scripts.dev: npm --workspace @sidekick/core run build && npm --workspace @sidekick/integrations run build && concurrently --success first -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run make --workspace @sidekick/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:runtime && npm run test:service && npm run test:maintenance && npm run test:release && npm run test:dependencies && npm run test:service:integration && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:service: node --test scripts/service-config.test.mjs scripts/service-lifecycle.integration.test.mjs scripts/windows-task-scheduler.integration.test.mjs scripts/macos-launch-agent.integration.test.mjs scripts/portable-symlinks.test.mjs scripts/recover-database.test.mjs scripts/desktop-smoke-plan.test.mjs apps/desktop/login-startup.test.mjs apps/desktop/log-writer.test.mjs apps/desktop/database-recovery-flow.test.mjs apps/desktop/mcp-endpoint.test.mjs apps/desktop/data-directory.test.mjs apps/desktop/background-tray.test.mjs apps/desktop/background-mode.test.mjs apps/desktop/startup-preference.test.mjs apps/desktop/update-check.test.mjs apps/desktop/native-updater.test.mjs apps/desktop/forge-config.test.mjs
scripts.test:service:integration: npm run build --workspace @sidekick/api && node --test scripts/service-runner.integration.test.mjs scripts/recover-database-salvage.test.mjs scripts/memory-import.integration.test.mjs scripts/twilio-conversation-sync.integration.test.mjs scripts/report-memory-consent.integration.test.mjs scripts/backup-archive.integration.test.mjs scripts/mcp-delivery.integration.test.mjs scripts/projection-sources.integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:dependencies: npm run build --workspace @sidekick/core && npm run build --workspace @sidekick/integrations
